findings.title: Policy allows all actions on all resources
findings.remediation: Replace with the specific actions and resources the identity needs.

findings.title: AdministratorAccess attached to a group
findings.detail: AdministratorAccess is attached to the group. Members: admin-user.
findings.remediation: Confirm this is an approved admin group, keep membership minimal, require MFA, and record the approval in approved_admins.

findings.title: AdministratorAccess attached to a role
findings.remediation: Replace with a scoped policy for what the workload needs.

findings.title: AdministratorAccess attached directly to a user
findings.remediation: Remove it and grant a scoped policy, preferably through a group.

findings.title: Console user without MFA
findings.detail: Console access is enabled and no MFA device is registered.

findings.title: User inherits administrator access through a group
findings.remediation: Confirm the user needs admin access, require MFA, and record the approval in approved_admins.

findings.title: Active access key that has never been used
findings.detail: Key is Active and has no recorded use.
